title: Keeping Invention Confidential
eligible_reason: Common date: post = after the federal Defend Trade Secrets Act (May 2016) for all wells; hts = high-treatment-sample states (lower pre-DTSA protection). Treatment post##hts switches on at one date; cont_post is a continuous-intensity version. Well-level cross-sections (each well observed once at completion) with basin/operator/service/well-type/month FE, no unit FE. Not staggered.
design_notes: Stata. Rystad ShaleWellCube well- and ingredient-level data, 2014-2018. Table 3: reghdfe {trade_secret, proportion_secrets_well, new_ts, new_combination, novel_addition} post##hts, absorb(basin operator service welltype month), cluster(state). Table 4: splits by noncompete enforcement, customer trust, rivals. Table 5: ingredient categories. Table 6: continuous treatment (cont_post). Tables 7-8: productivity (oilip30, gasip30) on trade_secret and post##trade_secret.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: DTSA effective date common to all states.

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment date (DTSA 2016); well-level cross-section without unit FE

data_files_note: README: proprietary Rystad Energy data; dataset_kin.dta not shipped. Package has code, log, output tables, figures (.gph) and a variable dictionary.
screener_notes: Common-date federal law with state-level pre-exposure contrast; not staggered. Data not shipped.
